title: Normality Criteria for Differential Monomials and the Sharpness of Lappan-type Theorems
summary: A fundamental result of Lappan [Comment. Math. Helv. \textbf{49} (1974), 492-495.] states that a meromorphic function $f$ in the unit disk $\mathbb{D}$ is normal if and only if its spherical derivative is bounded on a five-point subset $E \subset \mathbb{C}$. In this paper, we establish new normality criteria that bridge this classical result with contemporary trends in value distribution theory.
